data.title: 堀京子 · 超市晚市的特价攻略
data.description: 傍晚超市，她推着购物车熟练比对特价标签，把限时折扣的食材快速放进篮子；动作干脆利落，脸上是抢到好货的实在开心，完全没有校园女神包袱。
data.action: 推着购物车比较折扣标签，把选中的蔬菜放进篮子。
data.promptProse: Kyouko Hori compares discount labels at the supermarket, then quickly places the selected groceries into her cart with a practical satisfied smile. Her pale-grey sweatshirt and loose navy trousers stay casual, chestnut hair tied back. The medium portrait follows the aisle shelves and cart basket behind her working hands. Store lighting illuminates labels and packaging surfaces, with mild shelf shadows and reflected highlights along the metal cart rails.
